title: Crash Course: Odoo ERP
tagline: See how a business runs in Odoo: ERP basics, accounting, and the supply chain across CRM, Sales, Purchase and Inventory, brought together in one business case.
description: The best place to start if you are new to ERP. This course explains what business workflows are, why companies use ERP systems and where Odoo fits, then walks through the applications almost every company relies on.

You will learn accounting fundamentals, follow the supply chain from CRM and Sales to Purchase and Inventory, and see everything connected in a complete business case. Each session comes with reading material and a quick check, and the course ends with a final assessment.
learningOutcomes: Explain business workflows and the role of an ERP system
Describe how Odoo connects departments in one database
Understand the accounting fundamentals behind invoices, bills and payments
Follow the supply chain across CRM, Sales, Purchase and Inventory
Trace a complete business case from first contact to accounting
Choose the right next Odoo learning track
whoItsFor: Students and graduates building a practical ERP foundation before choosing a specialization
ERP beginners who want to enter Odoo without getting lost in technical complexity
Office professionals who need to understand the workflows behind daily administrative work
Career explorers evaluating functional, administrative, or technical Odoo directions
requirements: No prior ERP or Odoo experience
Basic digital literacy and browser use
Interest in business processes and technology
A laptop or desktop for practical activities

faq.question: How is this different from the Odoo User Guide?
faq.answer: The User Guide teaches the everyday tasks in each app. This course explains the bigger ERP picture: how the departments and their data connect in one business.

faq.question: Is accounting knowledge required?
faq.answer: No. The accounting session starts from the fundamentals.

faq.question: What format are the lessons?
faq.answer: Recorded video sessions with reading material, a quick check after each session, and a final assessment.

faq.question: What comes after this course?
faq.answer: Odoo User Guide for daily use, Odoo Implementation to configure Odoo for a business, or Python Fundamentals to start the technical track.
